findings.evidence: Line 10 applies `@[expose]` to the entire file, while `Datum.lean` unfolds imported definitions at lines 445, 511, and 569.
findings.fix: Remove `@[expose]`; add targeted equation/application lemmas for definitions such as `weight` and `coweight` wherever `Datum.lean` currently needs unfolding.
findings.issue: `@[expose] public section` exposes every model definition body, including implementation machinery, so downstream proofs can depend on representation details instead of the API.

findings.evidence: `rg` finds its declaration at Model.lean:337 and uses only at Datum.lean:257 and Datum.lean:272.
findings.fix: Make it `private` or move it to an appropriate general-purpose module if independent reuse is intended.
findings.issue: `pair_eq_of_mem_iff` is a completely generic implementation helper exposed inside the type-C namespace, despite serving only the datum's injectivity proof.

findings.evidence: These are advertised as the defining coordinate equations at lines 51–53; only `typeCSimpleIndex_val` currently carries `@[simp]`.
findings.issue: The main root and coroot characterization theorems (`root_typeCSimpleIndex` and `coroot_typeCSimpleIndex` at line 454) lack `@[simp]`, so simplification does not reduce the pinned datum on its designated simple indices to canonical coordinates.

summary: The public surface exposes implementation bodies and omits automation on its principal characterization lemmas.
